description_en: Sends a file to one or more Lingjun nodes
description_zh: 一台或多台灵骏机器下发远程文件
kebab_example: aliyun eflo-controller send-file --name file.txt --target-dir /home --content '#!/bin/bash_echo_Current_User_is_:_echo_ps_grep_awk_print_2_--------_oss://bucketName/objectName' --node-id-list i-bp1b00g1wdnrvpz68o0b --api-version 2022-12-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendFile

parameters.help_en: The file name. The name can be up to 255 characters in length and can contain any characters
parameters.help_zh: 文件名称。支持全字符集，长度不得超过255个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the file. The description can be up to 512 characters in length and can contain any characters
parameters.help_zh: 描述信息。支持全字符集，长度不得超过512个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The directory in the Lingjun node to which the file is sent. If the specified directory does not exist, the system creates the directory automatically
parameters.help_zh: 文件下发目标灵骏节点中的目录。如不存在则会自动创建
parameters.name: target_dir

parameters.help_en:
The content type of the file. Valid values:

PlainText Base64 Default value: PlainText
parameters.help_zh:
文件内容类型。

PlainText：普通文本。
Base64：Base64编码。
默认值为PlainText
parameters.name: content_type

parameters.example: #!/bin/bash echo "Current User is :" echo $(ps | grep "$$" | awk '{print $2}') -------- oss://bucketName/objectName
parameters.help_en:
The content of the file. The file must not exceed 32 KB in size after it is encoded in Base64.

If `ContentType` is set to `PlainText`, the value of Content is in plaintext.
If `ContentType` is set to `Base64`, the value of Content is Base64-encoded
parameters.help_zh:
文件内容。文件内容在Base64编码后，大小不能超过32 KB。

当`ContentType`参数为`PlainText`时，该字段为明文格式的普通文本。
当`ContentType`参数为`Base64`时，该字段为Base64编码的文本
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en:
The permissions on the file. This parameter takes effect only on Linux instances. You can configure this parameter in the same way as you configure the chmod command.

Default value: 0644: the owner of the file has the read and write permission. The user group of the file and other users have read-only permission
parameters.help_zh:
文件的权限。只对Linux实例生效，设置方式与chmod命令相同。

默认值为0644，表示用户具有读写权限，用户组和其它用户具有只读权限
parameters.name: file_mode

parameters.help_en: The owner of the file. This parameter takes effect only on Linux instances. Default value: root
parameters.help_zh: 文件的用户。只对Linux实例生效，默认为root
parameters.name: file_owner

parameters.help_en:
The user group of the file. This parameter takes effect only on Linux instances. Default value: root. The value can be up to 64 characters in length.

Note If you want to use a non-root user group, make sure that the user group exists in the instances
parameters.help_zh:
文件的用户组。只对Linux实例生效，默认为root。长度不得超过64个字符。

说明
使用其他用户组时，请确保实例中存在该用户组
parameters.name: file_group

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to overwrite file with the same name in the destination directory.

true
false

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
如果同名文件在目标目录已存在，是否覆盖文件。
true：覆盖。
false：不覆盖。

默认值为false
parameters.name: overwrite

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period for the file sending task. Unit: seconds.

A timeout error occurs when a file cannot be sent because the process slows down or because a specific module or Cloud Assistant Agent does not exist.
If the specified timeout period is less than 10 seconds, the system sets the timeout period to 10 seconds to ensure that the file can be sent.

Default value: 60
parameters.help_zh:
下发文件的超时时间。单位：秒。

当因为进程原因、缺失模块、缺失云助手Agent等原因无法下发文件时，会出现超时现象。
当设置的超时时间小于10秒时，为确保下发成功，系统会将超时时间自动设置为10秒。

默认值为60
parameters.name: timeout
